standard_prerequisites.use: Univalence, function extensionality, path and dependent-pair induction, suspension higher-inductive types, truncations and connected-type induction into truncated families. The wedge lemma and the entire source-local code construction are retained.

core_obligations: Construct the dependent family of truncated fibre codes using the wedge-connectivity argument and prove its transport identifications.
Contract every code fibre using the actual Freudenthal encode/transport proof, obtaining2n-connectedness of the canonical suspension-loop map.

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the dependent family of truncated fibre codes using the wedge-connectivity argument and prove its transport identifications.

difficulty_reason: The target is connectivity of the map itself, not merely an isomorphism of truncated loop types. The dependent code family and its contraction require a coordinated univalent transport construction, supporting H2.

compared.difference: Migrates this unpublished research claim once using the actual fixed official source; no second count beside the old record.
Homogeneous Freudenthal algebras/anisotropic quadratic forms is only a name collision, not suspension connectivity.
Hypercubical manifolds has a cubical presentation claim, not any of these three numbered book theorems.

dedup.scope: Exact book labels and source identities checked against public/retired/preparation and research-overlap metadata; the three selected statements concern distinct constructions, not alternate proofs. Old mispaired Freudenthal text excluded as a primary proof.
